page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines. Engraving or device in the centre below the text. Imprint lines at the foot. Red seal stamp at left, blue ink mark at lower left (not printed text).
page.notes: The title page is very faint, and the lines printed through from the reverse side are mirrored and cannot be separated from the real text, so most lines are marked as doubtful or illegible. The engraving in the centre is a faint, undescribed device and is not transcribed. The red seal at left and the blue ink mark at lower left are stains, not printed text. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
